subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw expose a core after-compaction reset API, and if so should the permanent plugin contract be only current-session-scoped resetSession(reason?) without the unshipped explicit-key overload?
rationale: This branch changes a public plugin API and grants session-replacement authority; repository policy requires owner intent rather than allowing automation to select or preserve that contract.

options.title: Current-session API only
options.body: Expose only resetSession(reason?) on successful, resettable after-compaction contexts and remove the explicit-key overload and unrelated tool-loop policies.

options.title: Approve both signatures
options.body: Adopt both call forms as supported plugin API and require explicit compatibility, security-boundary, and lifecycle coverage.

options.title: Keep reset owner-internal
options.body: Do not expose a core hook API and solve the recovery need through a narrower owner-controlled gateway or plugin seam.

recommendation.title: Current-session API only
recommendation.body: Expose only resetSession(reason?) on successful, resettable after-compaction contexts and remove the explicit-key overload and unrelated tool-loop policies.

likelyOwner.reason: The cross-runtime change includes the Codex app-server lifecycle they introduced and requires a core plugin/session contract decision.
